state: Hi there, so I bought four tickets last month for the Maple Street Fair concert through your site for my daughter's birthday and now it turns out the date conflicts with her school's fall recital which got moved up a week without much notice and I'm honestly scrambling to figure out what to do because she will be devastated if we can't go at all, so I was wondering if there's any way to swap our tickets for the Sunday afternoon show instead since I saw there are still seats available in the same section, we don't need our money back or anything like that, we just really want to still see the band, just not on a Friday night when she has to be on stage for her own thing, is that something your team can help with or do I need to call the venue directly, also if it helps I have the order number ready which is SM-58821, and I can send screenshots of the recital schedule if that speeds things along, we're just trying to make this work for everyone involved and appreciate any help you can give us here, thanks so much in advance for looking into it.
